method: Read the installed pinned package's commands/emulators-start.js and emulator/commandUtils.js before implementing the adapter. This is a CLI source contract, not a new wire capture.

boundary: The accepted native suite starts Firestore, Auth, Storage, Functions, Pub/Sub and supporting control services together. Do not pretend unsupported service subsets or other Firebase products work. Refuse unsupported configurations before starting children. No cloud fallback.
